user.title: Anova Precision Oven
user.description: Enter your Anova Personal Access Token

error.invalid_token: Invalid token format. Token must start with 'anova-'
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Anova API

start_cook.name: Start cook
start_cook.description: Start a cook with full control: sous vide or dry, heating elements, fan, steam, vent, rack, and a probe target or timer. Replaces any cook in progress.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Oven temperature, in your Home Assistant temperature unit. Dry: 77–482 °F (25–250 °C), 356 °F (180 °C) max with only the bottom element. Sous vide: up to 212 °F (100 °C).

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Dry heats on the dry bulb. Sous vide holds the wet bulb temperature with humidity.

heating_elements.name: Heating elements
heating_elements.description: Which elements to use. At least one.

steam.name: Steam
steam.description: Steam percentage in dry mode (0 = none). Relative humidity in sous vide mode (default 100).

rack_position.name: Rack position
rack_position.description: Rack position 1–5, as shown in the Anova app.

probe_temperature.name: Probe target
probe_temperature.description: Food probe target, in your Home Assistant temperature unit. Can't be combined with a timer.

duration.name: Timer
duration.description: Cook timer. Starts once preheated when preheat is on. Can't be combined with a probe target.

preheat.name: Preheat
preheat.description: Add a preheat stage so the cook (and its timer) starts once the oven is at temperature.

wait_for_start.name: Wait for start
wait_for_start.description: After preheating, wait for a tap on the oven before starting the cook stage (put the food in first). Needs preheat.

start_custom_cook.name: Start custom cook
start_custom_cook.description: Start a cook from raw Anova stages, e.g. copied from the Cook session sensor's stages attribute after starting a recipe in the Anova app. Replaces any cook in progress.

stages.name: Stages
stages.description: List of stage objects (YAML or JSON).
